name: all-clear
description: Codex tells you when a finished task no longer needs the chat and hands you a short note to paste after /clear.

interface.shortDescription: Start fresh after each task, keep a short note
interface.longDescription: When a task is done and the next one does not need the old chat, Codex writes a handoff note of 400 characters or less and tells you to type /clear and paste it. Fewer tokens per message, less drift.
defaultPrompt: Use all-clear: tell me when this chat can be cleared.
Write an all-clear handoff note for the next task.
